"'''Torrent Four'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. He was killed in the [[Thicket]] of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] when a probe droid hurled at him.
